E-grouse-drive-0084.parkWhat: pull off on McKay Rd (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Rosita-Meldrum FSR, 5.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
6 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
2 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 5-14, Region 5 Cariboo.
Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Chilcotin and M.U. 5-14. Closed between 4:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-2/23.
Private land 430 m N: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

plan: Drive: from 100 Mile House, about 132 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97, Oliver St, MacKenzie Ave N, Soda Creek Rd.
Park: 52.2761, -122.35912, pull off on McKay Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Rosita-Meldrum FSR stretch, 5.8 km one way. About 116 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-14, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-22, closures 2026-10-03.

E-moose-walk-0038.name: 3.3 km W of Coyote Lake
E-moose-walk-0038.pressureWhy: Busier: under 30 minutes from a city (estimate).

evidence.t: 10 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 6.7 ha, right here.
Burn from 2017 (fire C20735), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

Walk: 1.5 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1 m, about 29 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
